author_source: project/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/08_Laser Cutter 6.5 Updates/src.py

points.K1: 规程会更新，以最新为准
points.K2: 净化器风量调到新档位
points.S1: 闻到异味：停机、检查、报告
points.S2: 当心长得像亚克力的含氯塑料
points.S4: 规程更新要告知、要执行

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光切割机旁，举着一张空白通知单
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed desktop laser cutter holding up a blank notice sheet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 激光切割机的规程，有了新变化。
overlay: 激光切割机：规程更新须知

shots.scene: 风扇图标和一块透明板图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: an air purifier fan and a clear plastic sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 一条关于净化器，一条关于亚克力。

shots.scene: 阿杰按旧习惯把净化器调到三格，墙上贴着新通知
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sets the air purifier to three lights out of habit, while a new blank notice is posted on the wall above it.
shots.narration: 阿杰还按老办法开净化器。

shots.scene: 小研指着墙上的新通知，阿杰挠头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the new blank notice on the wall; the young male student scratches his head.
shots.narration: 小研提醒他：规程已经更新了。

shots.section_title: 规程会更新，以最新为准
shots.scene: 一本旧规程和一本新规程，新的上面有星标
shots.prompt_en: Two blank procedure booklets side by side, the newer one marked with a star icon. No people.
shots.narration: 培训视频拍完后，规程还会调整。
overlay: 规程会更新，以最新为准

shots.section_title: 规程会更新，以最新为准
shots.scene: 净化器上贴着更新后的空白标识
shots.prompt_en: A fresh blank sign with simple fan icons attached to the front of the air purifier. No people.
shots.narration: 一切以最新通知和现场标识为准。

shots.section_title: 净化器风量调到新档位
shots.scene: 净化器顶上的指示灯从三格亮到四格
shots.prompt_en: The indicator lights on top of the air purifier go from three lit lights to four lit lights. No people.
shots.narration: 净化器风量，调高到新的档位。
overlay: 净化器风量调到新档位

shots.section_title: 净化器风量调到新档位
shots.scene: 阿杰按风量键，数着亮起的灯
shots.prompt_en: The young male student taps the fan button on the air purifier and counts the lit indicator lights.
shots.narration: 每次开机，数一数灯亮了几格。

shots.section_title: 净化器风量调到新档位
shots.scene: 烟雾被更强的气流吸进管道
shots.prompt_en: Smoke from the laser cutter is pulled more strongly through the duct into the air purifier, shown with bold airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 风量大一点，烟尘抽得更干净。

shots.scene: 两块透明板图标，一块标着挤出、一块标着浇铸
shots.prompt_en: Two clear plastic sheet icons side by side, one with a roller pictogram and one with a mold pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 亚克力分挤出型和浇铸型两种。

shots.scene: 挤出型板冒出浓重气味线，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: The roller-type sheet icon gives off heavy wavy odor lines and is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 挤出型加工时气味太大，不再允许。

shots.scene: 浇铸型板打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The mold-type sheet icon with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 以后只用标明浇铸的亚克力。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一块包装好的透明板，查看空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a wrapped clear plastic sheet and checks its blank label closely.
shots.narration: 买的时候，先找浇铸这两个字。

shots.scene: 空白商品页上，标签、标题、描述、参数四处被放大镜依次扫过
shots.prompt_en: A blank product web page; a magnifying glass moves over four areas in turn: the label, the title, the description and the specifications table. No people.
shots.narration: 标签、标题、描述、规格参数都看看。

shots.scene: 其中一处亮起黄色高亮，打勾
shots.prompt_en: One spot on the blank page lights up with a yellow highlight and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 找到明确写着浇铸，才算数。

shots.scene: 阿杰在服务台向小研出示手机上的空白商品页
shots.prompt_en: At the front desk, the young male student shows the female graduate student a blank product page on his phone next to his clear sheet.
shots.narration: 签到时，要能出示这份证明。

shots.scene: 商家网站上的统一说明被高亮，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank store web page with one general statement highlighted in yellow and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 商家声明只卖浇铸型的，也可以。

shots.scene: 说不清来历的透明板被放到一边
shots.prompt_en: A clear plastic sheet with no label and a question mark is set aside on a shelf with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 拿不出证明，这块板就不能用。

shots.section_title: 当心长得像亚克力的含氯塑料
shots.scene: 欣欣举着两块看起来一样的透明板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two clear plastic sheets that look exactly alike.
shots.narration: 有些塑料，看着和亚克力一模一样。
overlay: 当心长得像亚克力的含氯塑料

shots.section_title: 当心长得像亚克力的含氯塑料
shots.scene: 其中一块冒出黄绿色烟雾，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: One of the sheets, shown as an icon, gives off a yellow-green cloud next to a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 含氯塑料一切，就放出有毒腐蚀气体。

shots.section_title: 当心长得像亚克力的含氯塑料
shots.scene: 没有标签的透明板被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled clear sheet with a question mark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 成分说不清的透明板，一律不切。

shots.section_title: 闻到异味：停机、检查、报告
shots.scene: 阿杰在运行的切割机旁皱眉捂鼻
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands beside the running laser cutter, frowning and covering his nose.
shots.narration: 加工时闻到明显异味，
overlay: 闻到异味：停机、检查、报告

shots.section_title: 闻到异味：停机、检查、报告
shots.scene: 手指按下暂停键
shots.prompt_en: A finger presses the pause button on the laser cutter. No people.
shots.narration: 说明烟气可能外逸，先暂停。

shots.section_title: 闻到异味：停机、检查、报告
shots.scene: 老李检查净化器和风管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the air purifier indicator lights and the duct connection behind the laser cutter.
shots.narration: 报告管理人员，检查风量和风管。

shots.section_title: 闻到异味：停机、检查、报告
shots.scene: 净化器报警灯亮，滤芯图标需要更换
shots.prompt_en: The air purifier shows a flashing warning light and a filter cartridge icon with a swap arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 滤芯该换了，由管理人员更换。

shots.scene: 亚克力边缘冒出小火苗的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a clear plastic sheet edge with a small flame under the laser head. No people.
shots.narration: 亚克力容易燃烧。

shots.scene: 小研坐在切割机旁看守，手靠近急停
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits beside the running laser cutter, watching through the tinted window with her hand near the emergency stop.
shots.narration: 切亚克力，更要一臂之内全程看守。

shots.scene: 急停、关盖、灭火器、电话119图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a red emergency stop button, a closed lid, a fire extinguisher and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 起火先急停关盖，控制不住拨119。

shots.section_title: 规程更新要告知、要执行
shots.scene: 王老师在公告栏贴上空白新规程，并召集学员
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator posts a blank new procedure sheet on a notice board and gathers several students around it.
shots.narration: 规程更新后，要通知到每位使用者。
overlay: 规程更新要告知、要执行

shots.section_title: 规程更新要告知、要执行
shots.scene: 阿杰在空白签名表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank acknowledgment sheet beside the notice board.
shots.narration: 看过、学过，签字确认。

shots.scene: 小研在服务台后微笑招手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and waves from behind the front desk.
shots.narration: 有疑问，随时问服务台工作人员。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现净化器四格灯和标识图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of an air purifier with lit lights and a blank sign.
shots.narration: 净化器风量，按现场标识开足。

shots.scene: 浇铸型板打勾、无标签板打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a mold-type sheet with a green check and an unlabeled sheet with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 亚克力认准浇铸，签到出示证明。

shots.scene: 鼻子、暂停键、报告三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a nose with odor lines, a pause button and a blank report form. No people.
shots.narration: 闻到异味就暂停，报告检查。

shots.scene: 欣欣在关好的切割机旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy closed desktop laser cutter and the air purifier.
shots.narration: 跟上新规程，安全不掉队，下次见！
